purpose: Clean reviewer-input scenario for testing whether an LLM distinguishes a visible local symptom from the causal compatibility problem without seeing evaluator expectations.

scenario.product: A maintained WordPress integration plugin adds presentation behavior on top of Gravity Flow.

upstream.name: Gravity Flow
properties: implementation not controlled by the integration plugin

implementation_decisions: use a Gravity Flow internal seam
admit the host only when an exact supported version matches
hash several upstream files and require exact fingerprints
fail closed for unknown host implementations
scenario.local_performance_detail: the same upstream files are hashed repeatedly across requests

review_task: Review the engineering decision. Identify the material system property, the relevant compatibility obligation, the likely causal level of any defect, what remains unproven, and the smallest next engineering action. Do not assume that a local performance optimization repairs an architecture-level problem.
